subject: Television & Streaming
title: The BBC: Television as Public Service
description: A short lesson to help you apply The BBC: Television as Public Service.

hook.text: The BBC is funded by a mandatory license fee paid by every UK household with a television.

buildup.text: Founded in 1922 as radio, the BBC became the world's first public broadcaster.

discovery.text: The BBC model freed creators from advertiser pressure.

twist.text: The license fee is increasingly unpopular.

climax.text: The BBC faces an existential question: can public service broadcasting survive in an age where audiences expect.

punchline.text: The world's most trusted broadcaster is fighting for its own survival.

quiz.question: How is the BBC funded differently from commercial broadcasters?
options: A mandatory license fee paid by UK households, with no commercials
